review_notes: I read the whole file and the imported definitions file Definitions/Def_HopfAlgebra_HopfKer.lean (coaction, hopfKer, canAlgHom, canMap, IsHopfGalois, balancingRelations). That file is a separate file, so it is not part of this target. The target adds two local definitions. `act` is the action of B-points on A-points through the coaction, and it is built from Algebra.TensorProduct.lift. `res` is ψ.comp (hopfKer π).val, which is just a restriction to a subalgebra. Neither is an independent, substantive competitor to an existing Mathlib concept. `res` is a thin abbreviation for AlgHom.comp with Subalgebra.val, and the file uses it only in `res_act` and in `exists_act_eq`. `act` is specific to this Hopf-Galois setting. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively, but I know of no Mathlib notion of a coaction-induced action on algebra homomorphisms that it would duplicate. The practical case for consolidation is unclear, so I abstain.
